title: Supporting Togetherness During the Holidays, Even When Care Needs Change
summary: Find support and peace of mind this holiday season with care at home that helps families stay connected, comfortable, and supported as needs change.
body_text: The holiday season is often filled with reflection, meaningful moments, and time spent reconnecting with family we may not see throughout the year. For many families, it can also be a time when changes in health, independence, or care needs of elderly or disabled loved ones become more noticeable. When care needs evolve, families are often faced with new decisions, questions, and emotions, especially during an already busy and stressful time of year. While traditions may look different than they once did, togetherness and meaningful connection remain possible with the right support in place. When Care Needs Change, Support Matters More Than Ever Health changes can emerge slowly over time or appear unexpectedly. During the holiday season, these changes often become more apparent as routines shift, the pace of life quickens, and families spend more time together. It can become apparent that individuals are experiencing increased physical or cognitive challenges, find everyday tasks more difficult, or require a higher level of medical or supportive care focused on comfort and quality of life. Facing these changes without guidance can feel overwhelming, especially when families are unsure of what support options are available. Professional care services can help families navigate evolving needs, offering expertise, reassurance, and personalized support that helps preserve comfort, stability, and peace of mind throughout the season and the rest of the year. How Care at Home Helps Families Stay Connected Care delivered in the home allows individuals to remain in familiar surroundings, close to the people, routines, and comforts that matter most. Across home care, home health, and hospice services, care at home supports not only physical needs, but emotional well-being and peace of mind as well. Thankfully, the support offered by the Addus HomeCare Family of Companies is as varied as our client’s and patient’s needs. Home Care provides non-clinical assistance with daily activities such as personal care, mobility, and household tasks. This support helps individuals maintain independence and allows families to focus less on day-to-day responsibilities and more on spending meaningful time together. Home Health offers skilled clinical care, including nursing, therapy, and medical oversight, delivered in the comfort of home. These services support recovery, ongoing health needs, and stability, helping individuals avoid unnecessary disruption during the holiday season. Hospice care supports individuals during the final stage of life by prioritizing comfort, dignity, and quality of life, while encouraging each person to live as fully and meaningfully as possible. Hospice teams also provide compassionate guidance and emotional support for families, helping create space for connection, presence, and meaningful moments during a deeply personal time. By supporting safety, comfort, and individualized care at home, these services help remove barriers that might otherwise limit time spent with loved ones. With the right level of support in place, families can remain focused on togetherness, even as care needs change. Partnering With Families Through Every Stage of Care Every care journey looks different, and needs will inevitably change over time. That’s why a personalized approach is essential. Healthcare is a conversation and care plans are tailored to each individual’s goals, preferences, and health needs, and they can be adjusted as circumstances evolve. For families, having a trusted care partner provides reassurance during a season that can feel uncertain when health challenges arise. It means knowing there is a team available to help navigate changes, answer questions, and provide consistent, reliable support for the people that matter most. This partnership allows families to spend less time worrying about logistics and more time focusing on connection, presence, and meaningful moments together. Togetherness, Supported As we age, change is inevitable. Even so, the holidays do not need to look the same to remain meaningful. Togetherness is often found in quieter moments, familiar routines, and simply being present with one another. Even as care needs change, families can continue to experience comfort, connection, and moments that matter most. With the right support at home, the focus remains on honoring each person’s journey and creating space for meaningful time together throughout the holiday season. title: Designing Ambient Excellence: How Gauzy Smart Glass and Shading Systems Elevate Aircraft Cabin Interiors
summary: Gauzy - Designing Ambient Excellence: How Gauzy Smart Glass and Shading Systems Elevate Aircraft Cabin Interiors - Vision Systems %
body_text: A designer’s guide to crafting branded, personalized, and immersive cabin experiences. In today’s premium aircraft cabins, ambience is one of the most influential design materials. Light, shadow, texture, and shifting levels of transparency shape how passengers feel from the moment they enter the cabin. For aeronautical interior designers, completion centers, and aircraft OEMs, Gauzy aviation smart glass and advanced shading systems introduce highly responsive tools that enable complete control over the cabin environment. These integrated technologies support the creation of aircraft interiors that are visually compelling, operationally efficient, and deeply aligned with the emotional and sensory expectations of modern aviation. Defining Brand Identity Through Smart Cabin Design A well-designed aircraft interior expresses identity without ever speaking. From the first step onboard, the cabin should reflect the values, mood, and visual legacy of the airline or private owner. Gauzy smart shading and aviation grade smart glass technologies expand the designer’s toolkit in meaningful ways. Designers can craft environments where color, texture, and visual transitions reinforce the brand. Whether for private jets or commercial aircrafts, shading and smart glass enable to weave brand colors, patterns, and moods into the passenger experience. Patterns and logos can be printed on textile shades or cut into the dimmable film surface, while integrated LED lighting reinforces the brand’s tone and personality. By transforming windows and lighting elements into living expressions of identity, designers create cabin environments that feel distinctive, elevated, and unforgettable. Creating Mood and Ambience with Precision Cabin Light Control Light is one of the strongest emotional cues in an aircraft. It defines comfort, influences spatial perception, and sets the rhythm of the in-flight experience. Gauzy aviation smart glass and shading systems allow designers to shape light with a precision that feels cinematic. Brightness can shift gradually to match circadian aligned flight phases. Morning flights can evoke a warm sunrise atmosphere. Afternoon flights can offer open brightness without glare. Evening journeys can create a calm, cocooned ambience that promotes relaxation and rest. These solutions integrate seamlessly with cabin mood lighting and interior control systems, enabling smooth transitions that support passenger well-being and reduce fatigue.

title: CooperCompanies Announces New Chair of the Board and Strategic Review
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about CooperCompanies's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_text: CooperCompanies Announces New Chair of the Board and Strategic Review Dec 4, 2025 PDF Version SAN RAMON, Calif., Dec. 04, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CooperCompanies (Nasdaq: COO), a leading medical device company, announced today that its Board of Directors has appointed Colleen Jay to succeed current Chair Robert Weiss, effective January 2, 2026. Mr. Weiss will remain on the Board and stand for reelection for the upcoming year, marking his final term. The Company also announced a formal strategic review aimed at identifying opportunities to enhance long-term shareholder value. “Bob’s vision, industry knowledge, and leadership have been key to our success. I’m deeply grateful for his commitment and look forward to continuing our work together,” said Al White, President and CEO. “I’m also thrilled the Board appointed Colleen as Chair. Her track record of driving growth through global operational leadership, transformational innovation, strategy and execution make her a fantastic choice for this role.” Ms. Jay has served on the Company’s Board since 2016. She retired from Procter & Gamble in 2017 as Global Division President after 32 years of increasing responsibility across the multinational consumer goods company. In her last operational role, she was President of the Global Beauty Specialty Business where she was responsible for several major brands and the successful divestiture of them. Prior to that, she led the multibillion-dollar Global Retail Hair Care and Color division of P&G from 2012 to 2015 and the Global Female Beauty division from 2010 to 2012. Robert Weiss has been a cornerstone of CooperCompanies success for nearly five decades, serving as CEO from 2007 until his retirement in 2018. He also served as President of CooperVision, COO, and CFO over his distinguished career. Strategic Review CooperCompanies values constructive input from its shareholders and remains committed to profitable, sustainable growth to drive long-term shareholder value. The Company is actively focused on improving performance in core markets, expanding market share, enhancing operational efficiency, and generating strong returns through disciplined capital deployment initiatives. As part of these efforts, its Board and Management, with the assistance of its advisors, are undergoing a formal and comprehensive strategic review of the Company’s businesses, corporate structure, strategy, operations and capital allocation priorities to identify any additional opportunities to simplify the Company’s business and unlock long-term value, including through partnerships, joint ventures, divestitures, mergers, business combinations and other transactions. During this period, the Company expects to focus capital deployment on repurchasing shares under the recently announced $2 billion share repurchase program. About CooperCompanies CooperCompanies (Nasdaq: COO) is a leading global medical device company focused on helping people experience life’s beautiful moments through its two business units, CooperVision and CooperSurgical. CooperVision is a trusted leader in the contact lens industry, helping to improve the way people see each day. CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most. Headquartered in San Ramon, CA, CooperCompanies has a workforce of more than 15,000, sells products in over 130 countries, and positively impacts over fifty million lives each year. For more information, please visit www.coopercos.com . title: Health Insurance Guide for Returning NRIs
summary: Returning to India? This NRI health insurance guide explains eligibility, documents, plan types, tax benefits, waiting periods, and tips for choosing the best coverage.
body_text: Health insurance is essential for NRIs returning to India due to rising healthcare costs. Hospital bills have significantly increased since you left, and international coverage like private insurance, NHS, or Medicare stops in India. Early planning is crucial to avoid high out-of-pocket expenses and waiting periods, which can be up to 36 months for pre-existing conditions. NRIs benefit from tax deductions under Section 80D, with limits up to ₹25,000 for self and family, and ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 for parents depending on age. Indian premiums are much lower than international ones,a family floater plan covering ₹1 crore could cost less annually than your monthly premium abroad. Plans offer access to over 35,000 network hospitals nationwide, including cashless treatment at top facilities. ‍ Why Health Insurance Is Essential for Returning NRIs Healthcare costs in India are markedly lower than abroad, but international policies often leave NRIs exposed during visits by excluding Indian procedures. Early purchase avoids rejection due to pre-existing conditions. Health insurance ensures access to quality care, especially for elderly parents managed from abroad. Benefits include: Cashless treatment across thousands of hospitals in India 24/7 customer support for emergencies Coverage for procedures not included in international policies ‍ Eligibility & Residency Requirements for Returning NRIs You can buy health insurance in India as an NRI with a valid Indian passport. To qualify, you should spend at least 182 days abroad, covering OCIs and PIOs too. Policies require being physically present at purchase or eKYC enabled for online applications. Once active, benefits such as waiting period completion and No Claim Bonus carry over upon your return. Key documents include: Valid address proof, Recent ITR returns, Attested passport copy, PAN details, Indian bank account info. Policies typically cover medical expenses only within India. Regulations by FEMA govern premium payments and claim settlements in Indian rupees or foreign currency accounts depending on the policy. If you’re considering returning home, you may also find our guide on moving back to India for NRIs helpful. ‍ Types of Health Insurance Plans Available in India Individual Health Insurance: Customized coverage tailored to one person's specific health status, age, and medical history. Ideal when family members have varying health needs or risk profiles, allowing personalized sum insured and premium rates. Family Floater Plans: Cost-effective single policy covering the entire family under one sum insured (e.g., ₹50 lakh). Any covered member can use the full amount for claims, making it perfect for young families with similar health profiles and shared risk. Senior Citizen Plans : Specialized coverage for those aged 60+, designed for elderly health challenges. Features include shorter waiting periods (12-48 months) for pre-existing conditions like diabetes/hypertension, lifetime renewability, annual health check-ups, home healthcare, and coverage for critical illnesses. Some plans offer day-1 PED coverage with add-ons. Top-Up and Super Top-Up Plans: Affordable add-on policies that activate after your base policy exhausts (e.g., ₹10 lakh base + ₹50 lakh super top-up = ₹60 lakh total). Super top-ups have no deductible for multiple claims, providing high coverage at low premiums for comprehensive protection. ‍ Pre-Existing Conditions: What Returning NRIs Must Know Pre-existing conditions usually carry waiting periods of 2-4 years. Concealing medical history leads to claim denials or policy cancellations. Buying policies abroad before return starts waiting period early, allowing faster coverage access on arrival. Premiums are higher for severe conditions and require medical proofs during application. ‍ Health Insurance Tax Benefits for NRIs NRIs paying health insurance premiums to IRDAI-approved insurers in India can claim tax deductions under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act. Key points include: Deduction limits: Up to ₹25,000 for premiums paid for self, spouse, and dependent children below 60 years. Up to ₹50,000 if the policyholder or any insured family member is a senior citizen (60+ years). Additional ₹25,000 deduction for health insurance premiums paid for parents below 60 years. Additional ₹50,000 deduction for parents who are senior citizens (60+ years). Combined maximum deduction reaches ₹1,00,000 when both the policyholder and parents are senior citizens. Premiums must be paid through non-cash modes, preferably from NRE/NRO bank accounts compliant with Indian regulations. NRIs must file an income tax return in India declaring their Indian-sourced income, such as rental income, to avail these deductions. Preventive health check-ups costs up to ₹5,000 are also deductible within the overall limit. NRIs are eligible to claim a Goods and Services Tax (GST) refund on health insurance premiums paid via NRE accounts, reducing the effective premium cost. These tax benefits offer significant relief on taxable income, encouraging NRIs to secure comprehensive health insurance coverage in India for themselves and their families, ensuring financial protection while maximizing savings. If you’re considering returning home, you may also find our guide on moving back to India for NRIs helpful. ‍ How to Select the Best Health Insurance Plan When selecting a health insurance plan as an NRI in India, consider the following key factors to ensure comprehensive protection and ease of management: Insurer Reputation and Claim Settlement Ratio : Choose insurers with a strong track record and high claim settlement ratios. Reliable insurers with positive customer feedback ensure smooth processing of claims and prompt support during emergencies. Hospital Network and Geographic Coverage : Verify the size and reach of the insurer’s cashless hospital network, ideally pan-India, to guarantee treatment availability across the country. Larger networks reduce out-of-pocket expenses and simplify access to care. Coverage Limits and Sub-limits : Examine sum insured amounts and sub-limits such as room rent caps and procedure limits. Plans with minimal or no sub-limits offer better financial protection during hospitalization. Waiting Periods for Pre-existing Conditions : Look for policies with shorter waiting periods or day-one coverage to get timely protection for chronic ailments or prior conditions, important especially for returning NRIs and senior citizens. Lifetime Renewability : Ensure the plan offers lifetime renewability to continue coverage without interruptions regardless of age or health status changes. Premium Affordability vs. Coverage : Balance the premium cost against the comprehensiveness of coverage. Opt for plans that provide maximum protection within your budget rather than just the cheapest option. Digital Accessibility and Customer Support : Select insurers offering robust online platforms for policy management, claim filing, and access to documents remotely. Good customer service with 24/7 support is crucial for NRIs managing policies from abroad. Additional Benefits : Consider value-added services like free health check-ups, maternity benefits, home healthcare, ambulance cover, and wellness programs which enhance overall benefits. By carefully evaluating these criteria, NRIs can choose health insurance plans tailored to their unique needs, offering peace of mind and financial security when seeking healthcare in India. ‍ Conclusion Planning health insurance early before returning to India minimizes uncovered risks and waiting periods. Opt for reputable insurers with wide hospital networks, lifetime renewability, and transparent pre-existing conditions policies. Digital access ensures smooth management from abroad. Platforms like iNRI can simplify plan comparisons and policy management for returning NRIs. A well-chosen policy secures your family's healthcare finances through your transition back to India. ‍ Frequently Asked Questions Q1. What are the key benefits of health insurance for returning NRIs? Provides financial protection against Indian healthcare costs, tax benefits, wide hospital network coverage, pre-existing condition coverage, and peace of mind. Q2. How can NRIs purchase health insurance in India before returning? With a valid Indian passport, NRIs can buy policies online or in-person, providing required documents and ensuring policy activation before return. Q3. What types of health insurance plans are available for returning NRIs? Options include Individual, Family Floater, Senior Citizen, and Top-Up/Super Top-Up Plans tailored to various needs. Q4. How do pre-existing conditions affect health insurance for returning NRIs? They require disclosure and involve waiting periods of 2-4 years. Early policy purchase abroad can reduce wait time before coverage starts. Q5. What factors should be considered when selecting a health insurance plan? Choose based on insurer reputation, claim ratio, network hospitals, coverage limits, waiting periods, lifetime renewability, geographic scope, and digital management features. ‍

title: Ovid Therapeutics Appoints Dr. Petra Kaufmann as Chief Medical Officer
summary: NEW YORK, Dec. 02, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ovid Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: OVID), a biopharmaceutical company developing small molecule medicines for...
body_text: NEW YORK, Dec. 02, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ovid Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: OVID), a biopharmaceutical company developing small molecule medicines for brain disorders with significant unmet need, today announced the appointment of Petra Kaufmann, M.D., M.S., F.A.A.N., as Chief Medical Officer. Dr. Kaufmann joins Ovid’s leadership team with responsibility for guiding clinical, medical, and regulatory strategy as the Company progresses a clinical pipeline of potential best- and first-in-class therapeutic candidates for conditions and symptoms driven by neuronal imbalance. Dr. Kaufmann brings extensive experience developing CNS therapeutics from first-in-human studies through to global regulatory approval. The foundation for her expert drug development perspectives began from her early career as a practicing neurologist who treated patients with refractory and treatment-resistant epilepsies and neuromuscular disorders. She has held leadership roles in biopharmaceutical companies and at the National Institutes of Health, where she directed national rare-disease research and clinical-trial infrastructure. Her background includes patient-focused trial design informed by cutting-edge biomarker strategies and quantitative clinical planning. She is a proven drug developer who will help guide the advancement of Ovid’s next-generation GABA-AT inhibitor, OV329, and the Company’s broad portfolio of first-in-class KCC2 direct activators. “Petra brings a compelling combination of creative drug development, regulatory experience and the deep care of a physician who has treated people suffering from complex neurological conditions,” said Meg Alexander, President and Chief Operating Officer of Ovid Therapeutics. “Her appointment strengthens our R&D organization, and we believe her expertise is well suited for translating and accelerating the development of our highly differentiated pipeline programs. The team and I look forward to working alongside Petra as we advance our mission to bring new classes of better, gentler medicines for patients and families who need them.” “I have dedicated my career to advancing therapies for people living with serious conditions of the brain, including seizures,” said Dr. Kaufmann. “What drew me to Ovid is its commitment to patient-focused development, grounded in rigorous science and differentiated mechanisms. I’m excited to join at this pivotal moment and look forward to working closely with Meg and the Ovid team to thoughtfully advance OV329 and our broader KCC2 portfolio, ensuring each program is guided by sound clinical principles and a deep understanding of patient needs.” Dr. Kaufmann joins Ovid from Vigil Neuroscience (acquired by Sanofi), where she served as Chief Medical Officer and oversaw the company’s medical, clinical, biomarker, patient advocacy and regulatory functions. Prior to Vigil, Dr. Kaufmann served as Chief Medical Officer of Affinia Therapeutics and as Senior Vice President, Clinical Development, Translational Medicine & Analytics of Novartis Gene Therapies, where she played a key leadership role in the development and global approvals of Zolgensma®, the first gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy. Previously, Dr. Kaufmann held senior roles at AveXis (acquired by Novartis) and served as Head of the Office of Rare Diseases Research at the National Institutes of Health (NIH), where she helped advance national research and clinical-trial infrastructure for rare and genetic conditions. While at the NIH, Dr. Kaufmann also served as a part-time reviewer for the Food and Drug Administration’s Division of Neurology Products. Dr. Kaufmann earned her M.D. from the University of Bonn, an M.S. in Biostatistics from Columbia University, and completed specialized training in epileptology and electroencephalography at the University of Bonn. Dr. Kaufmann trained in neurology and clinical neurophysiology at Columbia University Medical Center, where she later served as a tenured faculty member in the Department of Neurology. Dr. Kaufmann is a Fellow of the American Academy of Neurology. About Ovid Therapeutics Ovid Therapeutics Inc. is a New York-based biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing small molecule medicines for brain conditions with significant unmet need. Ovid is advancing a pipeline of novel targeted small molecule candidates that modulate the intrinsic and extrinsic factors involved in neuronal hyperexcitability causative of multiple neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders. Ovid is developing: OV329, a next-generation GABA-aminotransferase inhibitor, as a potential therapy for treatment-resistant seizures and other undisclosed indications; and OV350, OV4071 and others within a library of compounds that directly activate the KCC2 transporter, for multiple CNS disorders. For more information about these and other Ovid research programs, please visit www.ovidrx.com. Contact Investor Relations & Media Victoria Fort VFort@ovidrx.com 202.361.0445

title: Changelog: November 2025
summary: Discover launches with curated tweeks for the sites you visit, share pages get image galleries, profiles move to a dedicated page, and Tweeks Pro arrives.
body_text: You no longer have to build every tweek yourself. Discover launched this month and suggests curated tweeks for the sites you already visit, both on the web and inside the extension. Share pages were redesigned, profiles moved to their own page, and Tweeks Pro arrived. New Discover — Tweeks now suggests curated tweeks for the site you're on. A notification appears when tweeks are available for the current page, the Library tab shows what's popular for that site, and a new Discover page on the web lets you browse everything. Dismiss a suggestion and it stays dismissed. The catalog already has strong picks like Remove Sponsored Results from Google Search , an NYT Strands solver , and a quick "Not interested" button for X . Share pages with image galleries — Shared tweeks now support custom titles, descriptions, and screenshot galleries, so people can see what a tweek does before installing it. Profile page — Your tweeks now live on a dedicated profile page with search, filters, sorting, and pagination. Tweeks Pro — You can now upgrade to Pro from your profile and manage billing yourself. Generation queue — Click the generation counter in the popup to see everything currently generating, with a live timer and a cancel button for each. One-click installs from GreasyFork — Tweeks adds an install button directly on GreasyFork script pages, so you can pull any userscript into your library without leaving the site. Tweeks Discord — We opened a community Discord . Come share what you've built, or get help with a stubborn tweek. Synced sign-in — Signing in on the website now signs you in to the extension, and vice versa. Improved Clearer generation history — Items in the generation list now show whether they created a new tweek or updated an existing one. Apply without reloading — Newly enabled scripts show an Apply button so you can run them on the current page right away. Heavier pages — Generation can now handle much larger pages, so it works on complex sites that used to fail. Friendlier errors — Failed generations now show an error notification with a readable message. Onboarding refresh — New visuals and clearer guidance in the onboarding flow. Fixed Signed in but can't generate — Fixed an authentication bug that could block generation even while signed in. Site matching on Chrome — Tweeks targeting URLs with query parameters now run reliably. Share page titles — Shared tweeks now always display the right title. Reliability Generation now retries transient errors on its own, and page-capture uploads are more resilient. You should see fewer failed generations without doing anything differently. Extension Version Coverage This changelog covers extension versions 0.0.2.3 through 0.0.3.1. All changes are cross-browser unless noted otherwise.
